title: Value Proposition
lead: The unique bundle of value an IT organisation delivers to its customers and stakeholders — the why behind the operating model.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: A value proposition articulates what an organisation offers, for whom, and why it matters. In IT, it defines what the IT function delivers to the business — which problems it solves and which benefits it creates. A clear IT value proposition is the foundation of the IT Operating Model.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Every ITOM engagement starts with defining or validating the IT value proposition. It shapes the service portfolio, the operating model priorities and the metrics used to measure success. Without a clear value proposition, operating model design risks being technology-driven rather than value-driven.

items.desc: The tasks and goals the customer is trying to accomplish.
The obstacles, risks and frustrations the customer experiences.
The outcomes and benefits the customer desires.
How products and services create gains and relieve pains.
The alignment between what the customer needs and what IT delivers.
